props.name: theme
props._description: Colour role of the bar: `default`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info` or `misc`.

props.name: progresstype
props._description: `linear` draws a horizontal bar; `circular` draws a ring.

props.name: static

value.name: value
value._description: The authored progress figure used when `static` is true.

props._description: `true` means the progress figure is the authored `value`. `false` means it is driven at runtime.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.
